moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio wobble, written here): Card hangs from a pivot 14 px above its top edge and swings −27° → 18° → −11° → 6° → −2° → 0° at 0 / 22 / 42 / 60 / 76 / 90 % of a 2200 ms loop (site DOM demo), each swing eased in-out (bezier .45,.05,.2,1), then rests. Recipe: 1000 ms, −28° → 18° (400 ms) → −8° (670 ms) → 0°, elastic.out. Params: duration (1 s) · from: góc đầu (−28°) · pivot: điểm treo (trên giữa) · swings: số lần lắc.
